name: Soumyajit Mohapatra
title: Software Engineer
aboutMe: I'm a Software Engineer at Deloitte with over 5 years of experience in designing and building scalable, accessible, and high-performing digital products. Throughout my career, I have worked across web, mobile, and cloud platforms, delivering solutions that balance business requirements with exceptional user experiences. I enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and transforming them into intuitive, user-friendly applications that create measurable impact.

My technical expertise spans both front-end and back-end development. On the front end, I specialize in React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, React Native, HTML, CSS, and SCSS, building responsive applications and reusable component libraries that improve developer productivity and maintainability. On the back end, I work with Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, SQL, and AWS to develop scalable APIs, cloud-native services, and robust application architectures.

I have experience working across multiple industries, including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Medical & Life Sciences. This diverse domain exposure has strengthened my ability to understand complex business processes, adapt quickly to new challenges, and deliver technology solutions that align with organizational goals.

As an engineer, I am passionate about continuous learning, clean architecture, and building software that scales. Whether collaborating with cross-functional teams, mentoring developers, or architecting new solutions, I focus on delivering maintainable, performant, and accessible applications that provide long-term value for both businesses and end users.
